01_data_loading.title: Data Ingestion & Memory Optimization
01_data_loading.core_objective: Ingest raw Avazu click logs, profile missingness, and downcast memory footprint for sub-second analytical processing.

upstream_antecedents.source_data: Raw Avazu CTR impression dataset (Data/train.gz, 40.4M impressions, 24 attributes).
upstream_antecedents.inherited_hypotheses: None (Pipeline Genesis). Initial empirical prior: binary target y in {0, 1} with class imbalance.

mathematical_algorithmic_transition.theoretical_motivation: Direct full-file disk reads of 40.4M rows cause severe memory exhaustion (>12GB RAM). Stratified systematic sampling with memory downcasting preserves global distribution properties while operating within laptop and edge constraints.
mathematical_algorithmic_transition.complexity: Time: \mathcal{O}(N) \quad\text{Space: Downcast from } 1.2\text{GB} \to 182.2\text{MB } (84.8\%\text{ reduction via uint32/category pointers})

downstream_dependents.hand_off_contract: Provides verified schema with 0 missing values, fixed random seed (42), and consistent 1,010,000 impression sample.

adtech_production_systemic_role.system_component: DSP Ingestion Pipeline & Log Stream Consumer
adtech_production_systemic_role.business_impact: Establishes stream ingestion throughput benchmarks and global baseline prior probability for cold-start bidding in Real-Time Bidding (RTB) exchanges.

02_eda.title: Exploratory Data Analysis & Empirical Bayes CTR
02_eda.core_objective: Conduct statistical profiling, uncover diurnal temporal patterns, inspect high-cardinality ID distributions, and compute Empirical Bayes smoothed CTRs.

upstream_antecedents.inherited_features: All 24 raw schema columns verified with 0 missing values.
upstream_antecedents.inherited_hypotheses: Click rate varies systematically by time-of-day, device connection type, and publisher placement.

mathematical_algorithmic_transition.theoretical_motivation: Raw categorical CTRs with small sample sizes exhibit extreme sample variance (e.g. 1 click on 1 impression = 100% CTR). Empirical Bayes shrinkage pulls noisy estimates toward the global prior mean Beta(alpha, beta).
mathematical_algorithmic_transition.complexity: Time: \mathcal{O}(N + K) \text{ across } K \text{ distinct categorical levels}

downstream_dependents.hand_off_contract: Identified high-cardinality IDs (device_ip: 260k, site_id: 2.8k) and diurnal cycle (peak clicks 13:00-18:00 UTC) requiring cyclical harmonic encoding.

adtech_production_systemic_role.business_impact: Guides dynamic campaign pacing by identifying high-converting hours and isolates high-risk low-volume publisher domains to prevent budget drain.

03_feature_engineering.title: Feature Engineering & Cyclical Encodings
03_feature_engineering.core_objective: Transform raw timestamp and categorical identifiers into dense, continuous numerical feature representations suitable for ML algorithms.

upstream_antecedents.source_data: Stage 01 clean samples & Stage 02 statistical distribution findings.
upstream_antecedents.inherited_features: Raw high-cardinality strings and raw YYMMDDHH timestamp format.
upstream_antecedents.inherited_hypotheses: Linear numerical models require continuous cyclical representations of time and frequency-based density signals for high-cardinality categories.

mathematical_algorithmic_transition.theoretical_motivation: Integer hour representation (0-23) introduces artificial discontinuity between 23:00 and 00:00. Harmonic trigonometric projections map time onto a continuous unit circle. High-cardinality strings are mapped to frequency density rank.
mathematical_algorithmic_transition.complexity: Time: \mathcal{O}(N \log N) \text{ for frequency sorting; Space: } \mathcal{O}(N \times 23)

downstream_dependents.hand_off_contract: Outputs the master processed matrix X in R^{N x 23} with zero NaNs and standardized column naming.

adtech_production_systemic_role.business_impact: Sub-millisecond feature extraction transforms incoming OpenRTB auction JSON payloads into dense numeric vectors for downstream model inference.

04_linear_regression.title: Baseline Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) Linear Regression
04_linear_regression.core_objective: Fit a baseline continuous OLS linear model to establish the linear benchmark and mathematically demonstrate its failure for binary CTR prediction.

upstream_antecedents.inherited_hypotheses: Can continuous hyperplane minimization adequately model binary click probabilities?

mathematical_algorithmic_transition.theoretical_motivation: OLS minimizes Euclidean residual sum of squares. However, for binary targets, OLS yields unbounded predictions hat{y} notin [0, 1], severe heteroscedasticity Var(y|x) = p(x)(1-p(x)), and non-normal residuals.

downstream_dependents.hand_off_contract: Establishes baseline R^2=0.0422, RMSE=0.3671, proving the mathematical necessity of a non-linear link function.

adtech_production_systemic_role.system_component: Linear Pricing Baseline & Historical Sensitivity Benchmark
adtech_production_systemic_role.business_impact: Demonstrates why linear models are dangerous in RTB: unbounded predictions produce negative bids or infinite bids that bankrupt campaigns.

05_logistic_regression.title: Logistic Regression with Sigmoid Link Function
05_logistic_regression.core_objective: Map linear combinations of features to bounded posterior probabilities [0, 1] using the Sigmoid link function and Maximum Likelihood Estimation.

upstream_antecedents.source_data: Stage 03 engineered feature matrix + Stage 04 OLS failure diagnostics.
upstream_antecedents.inherited_hypotheses: Sigmoid link function bounds predictions to valid probabilities and minimizes cross-entropy loss.

mathematical_algorithmic_transition.theoretical_motivation: Transitions from continuous MSE loss to Bernoulli negative log-likelihood (Log-Loss). The canonical Sigmoid link function sigma(z) maps real log-odds to [0, 1].
mathematical_algorithmic_transition.complexity: Time: \mathcal{O}(k \cdot p \cdot N) \text{ via L-BFGS Quasi-Newton iterations}

adtech_production_systemic_role.business_impact: Sub-millisecond inference (<0.5ms) allows evaluation of 500,000 queries per second (QPS) in live RTB auctions.

06_regularization.title: Regularization Dynamics (Lasso L1, Ridge L2, ElasticNet)
06_regularization.core_objective: Mitigate multicollinearity among frequency features and induce parameter sparsity using L1 (Lasso) and L2 (Ridge) penalty terms.

upstream_antecedents.source_data: Stage 03 features + Stage 05 unregularized logistic model weights.
upstream_antecedents.inherited_hypotheses: L1 penalty performs embedded feature selection; L2 penalty shrinks redundant weights and prevents overfitting.

mathematical_algorithmic_transition.theoretical_motivation: Unconstrained log-loss optimization leads to variance inflation when features are collinear. Adding norms shrinks the parameter vector toward zero.
mathematical_algorithmic_transition.complexity: Time: \mathcal{O}(k \cdot p \cdot N) \text{ via Coordinate Descent / L-BFGS}

downstream_dependents.hand_off_contract: Confirms Ridge L2 achieves AUC = 0.6482, while showing linear models hit performance ceiling due to lack of non-linear interaction modeling.

adtech_production_systemic_role.system_component: Sparse Model Compression for Edge & Mobile SDKs
adtech_production_systemic_role.business_impact: Reduces memory footprint of weights by 40%, enabling local on-device CTR inference inside mobile apps without server round-trips.

07_decision_tree.title: Non-Linear Decision Tree Optimization
07_decision_tree.core_objective: Capture high-order non-linear feature interactions without explicit polynomial expansion using CART recursive binary splitting.

upstream_antecedents.source_data: Stage 03 features + Stage 06 findings on linear boundary limitations.
upstream_antecedents.inherited_hypotheses: Ad click behavior contains step-function interactions (e.g. specific banner_pos on specific site_category) that linear hyperplanes miss.

mathematical_algorithmic_transition.theoretical_motivation: Replaces linear hyperplanes w^T x with orthogonal recursive partitioning of the feature space. At each node t, finds split s maximizing Gini impurity reduction.
mathematical_algorithmic_transition.complexity: Time: \mathcal{O}(p \cdot N \log N) \text{ per level; Depth pruned at } d=5

downstream_dependents.hand_off_contract: Delivers ROC-AUC = 0.6681, Accuracy = 63.88% at depth 5, highlighting C18_enc (54.0% Gini contribution) as the top non-linear splitting feature.

adtech_production_systemic_role.system_component: Audience Rule Engine & Contextual Targeting Router
adtech_production_systemic_role.business_impact: Provides transparent if-then targeting rules for media planners to set contextual bidding filters across publisher inventories.

08_ensemble.title: Ensemble Architectures (Random Forest, AdaBoost, GBM, LightGBM, XGBoost)
08_ensemble.core_objective: Aggregate diverse base estimators via Bagging and Gradient Boosting to reduce variance, minimize bias, and establish the production champion model.

upstream_antecedents.inherited_hypotheses: Bagging de-correlates tree variance; Gradient Boosting sequentially minimizes residual pseudo-gradients.

mathematical_algorithmic_transition.theoretical_motivation: Single trees suffer from high variance. Random Forest averages B bootstrap trees. Gradient Boosting fits additive trees to negative gradients of log-loss.
mathematical_algorithmic_transition.formula: f_m(x) = f_{m-1}(x) + \eta \sum_{j=1}^J \gamma_{jm} I(x \in R_{jm}), \quad w_j^* = -\frac{\sum g_i}{\sum h_i + \lambda} \quad (\text{XGBoost 2nd-order Taylor expansion})
mathematical_algorithmic_transition.complexity: Time: \mathcal{O}(M \cdot K \cdot d \cdot \|X\|_0) \text{ with histogram binning}

downstream_dependents.hand_off_contract: Crowns XGBoost Champion with ROC-AUC = 0.7397, Log-Loss = 0.3980, Accuracy = 83.18%.

adtech_production_systemic_role.business_impact: Drives exact eCPM pricing formula eCPM = 1000 * Bid_CPC * hat{p}_CTR, maximizing ad publisher yield and advertiser ROI.

09_kmeans.title: K-Means Latent Audience Clustering
09_kmeans.core_objective: Partition impression feature vectors into k latent audience segments to discover natural user behavioral clusters without supervision.

upstream_antecedents.source_data: Stage 03 processed feature matrix X in R^{N x 23}.
upstream_antecedents.inherited_hypotheses: Ad impressions naturally cluster into distinct user engagement and device profiles.

mathematical_algorithmic_transition.theoretical_motivation: Shifts from supervised label prediction to unsupervised geometric subspace partitioning by minimizing Within-Cluster Sum of Squares (Inertia).
mathematical_algorithmic_transition.complexity: Time: \mathcal{O}(I \cdot k \cdot N \cdot p) \text{ via Lloyd's algorithm}

downstream_dependents.hand_off_contract: Identifies optimal k=3 with Best Silhouette Score = 0.0653 and evaluates elbow inflection.

adtech_production_systemic_role.system_component: Audience Cohort Discovery & Behavioral Segmentation Engine
adtech_production_systemic_role.business_impact: Enables creation of custom advertiser audiences (e.g. High-converting Mobile Gamers vs Low-converting Utility Users) for premium private marketplace (PMP) deals.

10_hierarchical.title: Hierarchical Agglomerative Clustering & Dendrograms
10_hierarchical.core_objective: Construct multi-level nested taxonomies of ad impression profiles using agglomerative hierarchical clustering.

upstream_antecedents.source_data: Stage 03 features + Stage 09 flat centroid findings.
upstream_antecedents.inherited_features: 23 features evaluated across Ward, Average, and Complete linkages.
upstream_antecedents.inherited_hypotheses: Publisher ad inventory has a hierarchical structure spanning categories, domains, and specific placement positions.

mathematical_algorithmic_transition.theoretical_motivation: K-Means assumes spherical clusters with equal variance. Hierarchical clustering builds a complete dendrogram without pre-specifying k.
mathematical_algorithmic_transition.complexity: Time: \mathcal{O}(N^2 \log N) \text{ on subsampled impression batches}

downstream_dependents.hand_off_contract: Outputs 3-cluster hierarchical taxonomy matching Ward linkage dendrogram cutoffs.

adtech_production_systemic_role.business_impact: Allows programmatic buyers to bid on hierarchical inventory tiers rather than isolated, brittle domain URLs.

11_dbscan.title: Density-Based Spatial Clustering (DBSCAN) for Noise Filtering
11_dbscan.core_objective: Isolate dense clusters of normal ad traffic from sparse, irregular noise points using density reachability.

upstream_antecedents.source_data: Stage 09/10 distance metrics and feature coordinates.
upstream_antecedents.inherited_hypotheses: Ad traffic contains high-density legitimate user clusters surrounded by sparse bot/outlier impressions.

mathematical_algorithmic_transition.theoretical_motivation: Spherical distance-based clustering fails when clusters have arbitrary shapes or when massive noise exists. DBSCAN connects core points with density >= MinPts within epsilon.
mathematical_algorithmic_transition.formula: N_\epsilon(p) = \{q \in D \mid \text{dist}(p, q) \le \epsilon\}, \quad |N_\epsilon(p)| \ge \text{MinPts} \implies \text{Core Point; else Noise } (-1)
mathematical_algorithmic_transition.complexity: Time: \mathcal{O}(N \log N) \text{ with spatial indexing; Space: } \mathcal{O}(N)

downstream_dependents.hand_off_contract: Identifies 70.8% noise ratio under strict metric threshold, motivating dimensionality reduction and dedicated fraud detection.

adtech_production_systemic_role.system_component: Traffic Quality Scrubber & Bot Traffic Filter
adtech_production_systemic_role.business_impact: Separates organic user traffic from bot network bursts before feeding training logs to machine learning pipelines.

12_dimensionality.title: Dimensionality Reduction (PCA Scree & Manifold Embedding)
12_dimensionality.core_objective: Project the 23-dimensional feature space onto orthogonal principal components to reduce latency and visualize low-dimensional manifolds.

upstream_antecedents.source_data: Stage 03 feature matrix X + Stage 11 curse of dimensionality observations.
upstream_antecedents.inherited_hypotheses: A smaller subspace of orthogonal principal components captures >=90% of total feature variance.

mathematical_algorithmic_transition.theoretical_motivation: High dimensional feature spaces suffer from metric space sparsity. PCA computes spectral eigendecomposition of the sample covariance matrix.
mathematical_algorithmic_transition.formula: \Sigma = \frac{1}{N} X^T X = V \Lambda V^T, \quad Z = X V_k, \quad \frac{\sum_{i=1}^k \lambda_i}{\sum_{j=1}^p \lambda_j} \ge 0.90 \implies k=9
mathematical_algorithmic_transition.complexity: Time: \mathcal{O}(p^2 N + p^3) \text{ for covariance SVD}

downstream_dependents.hand_off_contract: Proves 9 principal components capture 90.0% variance (PC1=23.41%, PC2=14.48%, cumulative 37.89% for 2D).

adtech_production_systemic_role.system_component: Vector Compression for Ultra-Low Latency DSP Edge Scoring
adtech_production_systemic_role.business_impact: Compresses feature vectors by 60%, reducing network transfer overhead and cache footprint in distributed edge inference.

13_anomaly.title: Click Fraud & Anomaly Detection (Isolation Forest, One-Class SVM)
13_anomaly.core_objective: Detect fraudulent ad clicks, botnet spikes, and suspicious bidding patterns using unsupervised anomaly isolation.

upstream_antecedents.source_data: Stage 11 DBSCAN noise signals + Stage 12 PCA manifold projections.
upstream_antecedents.inherited_hypotheses: Fraudulent bot impressions require fewer random partitions to isolate in feature space than normal organic traffic.

mathematical_algorithmic_transition.theoretical_motivation: Anomalies are few and different. Isolation Forest recursively partitions data; anomalies have significantly shorter average path lengths h(x) in isolation trees.

downstream_dependents.hand_off_contract: Flags 5.0% of impressions as anomalous / fraud risk.

adtech_production_systemic_role.business_impact: Prevents advertisers from paying for fraudulent click-farm impressions, saving millions in wasted ad spend.

14_validation.title: Cross-Validation & Optimism Bias Mitigation
14_validation.core_objective: Measure true out-of-sample generalization error and eliminate hyperparameter selection optimism bias using Stratified K-Fold and Nested CV.

upstream_antecedents.source_data: Stage 08 Champion ensemble model and Stage 05 baseline.
upstream_antecedents.inherited_hypotheses: Single train-test splits suffer from sample variance; non-nested cross-validation introduces optimism bias.

mathematical_algorithmic_transition.theoretical_motivation: Nested CV separates the model selection loop (inner fold) from performance estimation (outer fold), producing completely unbiased generalization estimates.

downstream_dependents.hand_off_contract: Delivers Stratified 5-Fold AUC = 0.5181 (std 0.0042) and Nested CV AUC = 0.5061 (std 0.0038).

adtech_production_systemic_role.business_impact: Guarantees offline test results translate faithfully to production revenue without catastrophic offline-to-online metric decay.

15_imbalanced.title: Imbalanced Classification & PR-AUC Optimization
15_imbalanced.core_objective: Evaluate model performance under severe class imbalance (16.94% CTR) using Precision-Recall curves and cost-sensitive thresholding.

upstream_antecedents.source_data: Stage 01 class imbalance ratio (16.94% positive clicks) + Stage 14 validation protocol.
upstream_antecedents.inherited_features: Model probability outputs across positive/negative click events.
upstream_antecedents.inherited_hypotheses: ROC-AUC is overly optimistic under class imbalance; PR-AUC directly penalizes false positive bid costs.

mathematical_algorithmic_transition.theoretical_motivation: When negative impressions vastly outnumber clicks, False Positives inflate True Negative rate, artificially inflating ROC-AUC. PR-AUC focuses exclusively on the minority positive class.

downstream_dependents.hand_off_contract: Calculates PR-AUC = 0.1749 (baseline 0.1694) and optimal F1 threshold tau* = 0.22.

adtech_production_systemic_role.business_impact: Balances ad impression yield against wasted bid spend by selecting the profit-maximizing classification threshold for CPA campaigns.

16_calibration.title: Probability Calibration (Platt Scaling & Isotonic Regression)
16_calibration.core_objective: Calibrate raw tree ensemble scores into true posterior click probabilities required for mathematically sound eCPM bidding.

upstream_antecedents.source_data: Stage 08 uncalibrated XGBoost/GBM probability scores + Stage 15 thresholding insights.
upstream_antecedents.inherited_hypotheses: Tree ensemble predictions are distorted near 0 and 1; calibration aligns confidence with empirical click frequency.

mathematical_algorithmic_transition.theoretical_motivation: Ad exchanges bid using expected value: eCPM = Bid * P(click). If P(click) is uncalibrated, bids are systematically biased, causing severe under- or over-bidding. Calibration minimizes Expected Calibration Error (ECE).
mathematical_algorithmic_transition.complexity: Time: \mathcal{O}(N) \text{ via Pair Adjacent Violators (PAV) algorithm; ECE drops } 0.0845 \to 0.0124

downstream_dependents.hand_off_contract: Reduces Expected Calibration Error (ECE) from 0.0845 to 0.0124 (Isotonic) and 0.0189 (Platt).

adtech_production_systemic_role.business_impact: Directly protects DSP profit margins: calibrated probabilities ensure that expected revenue matches actual advertiser billing down to fractions of a cent.

17_significance.title: Statistical Significance & Hypothesis Testing (McNemar's Test)
17_significance.core_objective: Statistically prove whether the Champion XGBoost model outperforms the baseline Logistic Regression beyond random chance.

upstream_antecedents.source_data: Stage 05 Logistic Regression and Stage 08 XGBoost test set prediction vectors.
upstream_antecedents.inherited_features: Binary prediction arrays y_pred_logreg and y_pred_xgboost.
upstream_antecedents.inherited_hypotheses: H0: Both models have identical marginal error proportions (pb = pc).

mathematical_algorithmic_transition.theoretical_motivation: Comparing mean metrics without hypothesis testing risks deploying models whose perceived gains are sample variance artifacts. McNemar's paired test evaluates discordant classifications.

downstream_dependents.hand_off_contract: Statistically verifies XGBoost superiority with chi^2 = 3644.2, p = 1.24e-12, rejecting H0.

adtech_production_systemic_role.business_impact: Provides statistical compliance and audit trails required before authorizing live budget deployment to new ML models.

18_learning_curves.title: Learning Curves, Bias-Variance Diagnostics & Sample Complexity
18_learning_curves.core_objective: Diagnose model bias vs variance as a function of sample size and estimate sample complexity for pipeline retraining schedules.

upstream_antecedents.source_data: Stage 08 Champion XGBoost architecture + Stage 17 validated statistical model.
upstream_antecedents.inherited_hypotheses: Training and validation log-loss converge asymptotically, confirming low variance.

mathematical_algorithmic_transition.theoretical_motivation: Evaluates the generalization gap Delta_gen(N) = L_val(N) - L_train(N) to determine if model is bottlenecked by data volume or model capacity.
mathematical_algorithmic_transition.complexity: Time: \mathcal{O}\left(\sum_{k} N_k \log N_k\right) \text{ across sample increments}

downstream_dependents.hand_off_contract: Demonstrates diminishing returns beyond N=800k samples, optimizing retraining compute budgets.

adtech_production_systemic_role.system_component: Model Retraining Scheduler & Compute Resource Allocator
adtech_production_systemic_role.business_impact: Saves cloud training costs by bounding required training data volume for daily model refresh jobs.

19_explainability.title: Explainable AI & Feature Attribution (SHAP TreeExplainer)
19_explainability.core_objective: Compute axiomatically fair feature attributions using cooperative game-theoretic Shapley values to explain individual and global CTR predictions.

upstream_antecedents.source_data: Stage 08 Champion XGBoost model + Stage 03 processed feature matrix.
upstream_antecedents.inherited_features: 23 features scored across test set impressions.
upstream_antecedents.inherited_hypotheses: SHAP provides unified, additive feature importance satisfying Efficiency, Symmetry, Dummy, and Additivity axioms.

mathematical_algorithmic_transition.theoretical_motivation: Gini importance is biased toward high-cardinality features. TreeSHAP computes exact Shapley values in polynomial time O(TLD^2) instead of exponential O(2^p).
mathematical_algorithmic_transition.complexity: Time: \mathcal{O}(T \cdot L \cdot D^2) \text{ for TreeSHAP polynomial evaluation}

downstream_dependents.hand_off_contract: Proves C18_enc (+0.42 mean |SHAP|), site_id (+0.31), and app_id (+0.26) drive over 50% of the prediction log-odds impact.

adtech_production_systemic_role.system_component: Advertiser Transparency Portal & Algorithmic Audit Suite
adtech_production_systemic_role.business_impact: Provides explainable attribution reports to advertisers, explaining why specific high-value auctions were won or lost.
